instruction: A candid indoor portrait, medium shot, shows three children sitting close together on a couch. On the left, the boy with glasses (R1) in a gray hoodie over a green t-shirt smiles widely. In the center, the girl with curly hair (R3) wearing a gray sweatshirt and a dark hair bow smiles at the camera with her arms wrapped around her friends' shoulders. On the right, the girl with straight hair and bangs (R4) in a teal cardigan smiles gently. The scene is illuminated by soft, even indoor lighting with a bright, clean palette.
